blocks.text: Mental Health Counseling: A Guide for Pilots and Air Traffic Control Specialists (ATCS)
blocks.html: Mental Health Counseling: A Guide for Pilots and Air Traffic Control Specialists (ATCS)

blocks.text: Maintaining mental health is crucial for ensuring both safety and operational performance. Counseling or therapy is encouraged when medically appropriate.
